docs.author: Dr. Beatriz Campos
sentences: Patient is a 68-year-old woman with low back pain for about two months.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

sentences: Two views of the lumbar spine were obtained.
Mild disc space narrowing at L4-L5 with no fracture.
Sleeps about six hours a night.

payer_letter: Harborline Medicare Advantage has reviewed claim A-1004 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of a prior lumbar spine X-ray together with at least six weeks of conservative treatment, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray. You may request reconsideration within 60 days of this notice.
